commands.review_summary:
Adds 12-second `withTimeout` guards to several Zalo Personal account, friend, group, member, voice-upload, and voice-send API calls, plus controlled hanging-promise tests.

PR surface: Source +20, Tests +272. Total +292 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: current main directly awaits several dependency Promises with no bound, and a never-settling API method demonstrably leaves those callers pending. A real Zalo outage was not reproduced.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The blockers are concrete and mechanically repairable on the PR branch: complete the read-only lookup coverage and remove unsafe non-cancelling outbound guards.

target.title: fix(zalouser): add timeouts to account and group info lookups
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Zalo account and group information lookups could hang indefinitely when the underlying zca-js API calls stalled before responding, blocking `listZaloFriends`, `listZaloGroups`, `listZaloGroupMembers`, and `checkZaloAuthenticated` (which already had the guard) from returning control to callers.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each Zalo lookup call now passes a focused 12 second timeout into the existing `withTimeout` SDK helper. The helper is already imported into `zalo-js.ts` and used by the sibling `checkZaloAuthenticated` probe; the same pattern is now applied to the previously-untimed `fetchAccountInfo` (in `resolveOwnUserId`), `getAllFriends`, `getAllGroups`, `getGroupInfo` (in `fetchGroupsByIds` chunk loop and in `listZaloGroupMembers`), `getGroupMembersInfo`, `uploadAttachment` (in `sendZaloVoice`), and `sendVoice`. The change reuses the existing helper without altering any public API, config, or behavior on the normal fast path.

## User Impact

Zalo configuration, friend list, group list, and group member flows fail quickly (within 12 seconds) when zca-js stops responding, instead of blocking target resolution, channel allowlist lookups, and member enumeration. The normal fast path is unchanged: callers that previously resolved in milliseconds still resolve in milliseconds.

## Evidence

Exact head after normal commit on top of `origin/main`: `f1c0233ca755ff65886bf0ad03075fc407c47805`.

Validation run:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/zalouser/src/zalo-js.timeout.test.ts
-> 1 file passed, 8 tests passed
  - checkZaloAuthenticated aborts within ~12s when fetchAccountInfo stalls (19.7s wall, includes mock login)
  - listZaloFriends aborts within ~12s when getAllFriends stalls (12.3s)
  - listZaloGroups aborts within ~12s when getAllGroups stalls (12.3s)
  - listZaloGroups aborts within ~12s when getGroupInfo (chunk fetch) stalls (12.3s)
  - listZaloGroupMembers aborts within ~12s when getGroupInfo stalls (12.3s)
  - checkZaloAuthenticated resolves quickly when fetchAccountInfo responds normally (0.24s)
  - listZaloFriends returns the mapped friend list when getAllFriends responds normally (0.15s)
  - control-red: withTimeout guard must fire (12.1s) — guard missing would hang forever

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/zalouser/src/zalo-js.ts extensions/zalouser/src/zalo-js.timeout.test.ts
-> clean

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs
-> clean

git diff --check origin/main -- extensions/zalouser/src/zalo-js.ts extensions/zalouser/src/zalo-js.timeout.test.ts
-> clean
```

Real abort timing proof (each row is a vitest test that drives the production function path with a hanging zca-js API method and measures wall-clock elapsed until the guard fires):

| Caller | Hanging zca-js method | Wall-clock elapsed | Expected error fragment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkZaloAuthenticated` | `api.fetchAccountInfo()` | ~19.7s (incl. login) / ~12.1s (control-red) | `Timed out checking Zalo session` |
| `listZaloFriends` | `api.getAllFriends()` | 12.28s | `Timed out fetching Zalo friend list` |
| `listZaloGroups` | `api.getAllGroups()` | 12.35s | `Timed out fetching Zalo group list` |
| `listZaloGroups` (chunk fetch) | `api.getGroupInfo()` | 12.26s | `Timed out fetching Zalo group info` |
| `listZaloGroupMembers` | `api.getGroupInfo()` | 12.28s | `Timed out fetching Zalo group info` |

Observed behavior:

- The production `withTimeout` guard fires inside the 12s budget on every hanging call site.
- `checkZaloAuthenticated` swallows the underlying timeout and returns `false`; the test verifies it returns within the window instead of hanging.
- The control-red test sets a 16s watchdog and would throw a `regression: ... did not abort within 16s` failure if the guard ever stops firing.
- The normal-path tests (no stall) resolve in under 300ms, proving the guard does not affect fast paths.

Harness shape: each test mocks `./zca-client.js` to provide a fake `Zalo` constructor whose `login()` returns a fake `API` whose specific method returns a never-resolving Promise. Tests then drive the real exported functions (`checkZaloAuthenticated`, `listZaloFriends`, `listZaloGroups`, `listZaloGroupMembers`) and assert the production guard fires. No mocked `fetch` or response stream — the timeout fires against an actually-pending Promise inside the real production wrapper.

Known limits:

- This is controlled-runtime proof using a hanging Promise, not a real zalo-js API outage reproduction. The zca-js npm package is closed-source and we cannot route its internal HTTP calls to a local stalled server.
- Remote Testbox/Crabbox proof was unavailable in this environment; this used the documented narrow local fallback plus GitHub CI.
